prompt: /create-plan Refactor the thoughts-management skill to support custom directory structures via a config file instead of hardcoded paths

assertions.text: Response shows evidence of reading and analyzing the current thoughts-management scripts (thoughts-init, thoughts-metadata)
Response identifies specific hardcoded paths or directory names in the current implementation
Plan follows the template structure: Overview, Current State Analysis, Desired End State, Implementation Phases, Success Criteria
Plan proposes incremental changes across multiple phases rather than a single big-bang rewrite
Each phase includes verifiable success criteria with automated verification commands
Plan addresses backward compatibility or includes a migration strategy for existing thoughts/ directories
